image_description: A close-up photograph of a male Brambling (Fringilla montifringilla) perched on a thin, leafless branch. The bird displays characteristic breeding plumage with a black head and throat, bright orange-rufous breast, white belly, and dark brown/black back with white shoulder patches. The background is a soft, out-of-focus bokeh of browns and greens.
